scope.closure_reason: The controlled-pilot runtime renders quality_metadata.exam_value directly as front.context. Forty-five selected cards exposed content-production phrasing such as 让用户、训练用户、训练考生 instead of learner-facing micro-coaching copy; three lock cards also had front/runtime word-bank drift, and two writing cards contained malformed learner-visible analysis openings.
source_issue_refs: controlled-pilot candidate payload: 45 selected front.context values contained author-facing user/learner training language
manual word-bank mirror audit: 020208, 022005, and 022007 front candidates differed from runtime word_bank
manual writing audit: 030003 and 030004 analysis openings contained 正确判断是否 / 正确判断是是
